subject: research CLI output restyled; OpenResearcher gained progress=
body: The research command now prints a setup panel, live per-iteration progress and results tables (autoresearch/ui.py, autoresearch/research/display.py). OpenResearcher takes an optional progress callable: it receives every log event plus display-only 'iteration' and 'progress' events. It defaults to None and does not change runs (tested). The old flat 'baseline score ... ' and 'report: <path>' print lines are gone; if a script parsed them, read the report JSON instead. Colour is off when piped; NO_COLOR / FORCE_COLOR are respected.
